data.title: Articles of Incorporation (Worker Cooperative)
data.content:
# Articles of Incorporation of Worker Cooperative

## Article I: Democratic Identity
The Cooperative is organized as a worker cooperative under applicable cooperative corporation law.

## Article II: Rochdale Cooperative Principles
The Cooperative strictly adheres to the International Cooperative Alliance principles:
1. Voluntary and Open Membership
2. Democratic Member Control (One Member, One Vote)
3. Member Economic Participation
4. Autonomy and Independence
5. Education, Training, and Information
6. Cooperation among Cooperatives
7. Concern for Community

## Article III: Worker Ownership and Equality
Only natural persons actively employed by the Cooperative shall be eligible for worker-membership. Each member holds exactly one voting membership share.
data.notes: Initial founding document ratified at genesis

data.title: Worker-Owner Cooperative Bylaws
data.content:
# Worker Cooperative Bylaws

## Article 1: Membership Criteria and Candidacy
1.1 Candidacy Period: New prospective worker-members undergo a 6-month trial and mentorship period.
1.2 Admission to Membership: Admission requires approval by a 75% affirmative vote of the General Assembly via LegitBlock vote.

## Article 2: Governance & Democratic Assembly
2.1 Supreme Authority: The General Assembly of all worker-members is the highest governing body.
2.2 One-Member One-Vote: Voting power is strictly equal, regardless of capital contributions.

## Article 3: Internal Capital Accounts and Patronage Dividends
3.1 Patronage Basis: Net surplus is allocated to members based on hours worked (labor patronage), not capital invested.
3.2 Collective Reserve: At least 20% of net surplus is retained in an indivisible collective reserve.
